rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-13 before acquisition: robots.txt standard WordPress (Disallow: /wp-admin/ and podscache only, no AI-agent blocks, no content-signals); the site shows an Aviso Legal label but its destination is 404 and no terms-of-use page was located on home or catalog; the congress itself publishes direct download links. Quarantine only; no publication, no product activation. Stop the source if any restriction or challenge appears.
